questions.question: The Sadducees told Jesus about a woman who married seven brothers in turn. What did they ask about her in the resurrection?

answers.text: Which brother will be her husband
Which brother she loved the most
Which brother will inherit her land

questions.question: When the Sadducees questioned Jesus about the resurrection, why did He say they were mistaken?

answers.text: They don't know the Scriptures or God's power
They spoke without asking the priests first
They brought their question on the Sabbath

questions.question: Jesus taught that in the resurrection, people will keep marrying just like they do now. True or false?
When Jesus answered the Sadducees about the resurrection, He said God is not the God of the dead, but of whom?
